categories.main_business_segments: Fulgent Sun International primarily operates in the footwear manufacturing and sales industry, focusing on OEM production of various types of shoes including running, hiking, mountaineering, and casual sports shoes. The company also engages in the production and sales of shoe materials and accessories through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies such as programmable sewing machines, automated cutting and punching equipment, and utilizes innovative materials including waterproof, breathable, anti-slip, conductive, and heat-retaining shoe components. It emphasizes automation and smart manufacturing to improve efficiency and product quality, with certifications like ISO9001, GORE-TEX, and SATRA laboratory standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Fulgent Sun serves over 50 international well-known brands in the sports and outdoor footwear sectors, with major sales markets in Europe (44.28%), the Americas (39.08%, predominantly the US), and Asia (15.11%). Its customers are primarily global sports and outdoor shoe brands requiring high-quality, functional footwear.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities and subsidiaries across multiple countries including Vietnam, Cambodia, China, Indonesia, Taiwan, and Hong Kong. Its production capacity is mainly concentrated in Vietnam (58.93%), Cambodia (27.47%), and China (13.60%), supporting a global sales footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fulgent Sun functions as a midstream contract manufacturer (OEM) in the footwear supply chain, sourcing raw materials from upstream suppliers and producing finished shoes for downstream brand owners and retailers. It also manages procurement and supply chain logistics to ensure stable production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes capacity expansion with diversified production bases, smart manufacturing upgrades, and digital transformation. R&D focuses on developing high-value-added functional footwear, sustainable and recycled materials, automation technologies, and new shoe sole formulas. ESG initiatives include carbon neutrality, energy efficiency, and compliance with international environmental standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through contract manufacturing and sales of footwear products to international brand clients. The company also derives income from sales of shoe materials and accessories, with a multi-brand order strategy to stabilize revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Fulgent Sun competes in the global footwear OEM industry, distinguished by its broad product line, multi-brand client base, and advanced manufacturing capabilities. It maintains a competitive edge through vertical integration, flexible production for high-value functional shoes, and strategic geographic diversification to mitigate risks.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$14.6 billion with a gross margin of 19.08% and operating profit margin of 8.70%. Despite a slight revenue decline due to global economic uncertainties, it sustained strong profitability with net income attributable to the parent company of NT$1.376 billion and EPS of NT$7.23. The company continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, indicating a growth-oriented profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fulgent Sun offers high-quality, technologically advanced footwear manufacturing services with a focus on innovation, speed, and flexibility. Its ability to produce diverse, functional, and sustainable shoe products for leading global brands, combined with smart manufacturing and stringent quality controls, differentiates it in a competitive market.
